evidence_slice: Devon County Council's official public MapServer layer 669 is named Listed buildings, uses esriGeometryPolygon geometry, and binds DesigUID, ListEntry, Name, Grade, NGR, Easting, Northing and NHLE_URL fields to polygon features. The layer is maintained and amended by the Devon & Dartmoor Historic Environment Record based on Historic England data and covers Devon, Torbay and Dartmoor HER administrative areas, with central Exeter records noted as out of date. The distinct exact public no-login query for ListEntry 1306502 (Bridge Inn, Topsham, Exeter) could not be retrieved through the available web channel, and direct network resolution failed before any feature payload could be read. The prior immutable batch already evidences the target identity/type-use as Bridge Inn/public house, but this new source window returned no target polygon coordinates; no footprint was inferred or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Devon County Council MapServer layer 669 is an official esriGeometryPolygon layer, but the exact ListEntry 1306502 query payload was not retrievable, so no polygon coordinates were read.
field_evidence.identity: Layer schema directly binds ListEntry, Name and Grade to polygon features; target ListEntry 1306502 identity was previously evidenced in immutable batch_0084, but the new DCC record payload was not returned.
field_evidence.type_use: Prior immutable batch_0084 evidences ListEntry 1306502 as Bridge Inn/coaching inn/public house; this new DCC source window did not return the target feature payload.
